description: Read a work from the shelf. Without a section: its table of contents (with paragraph counts). With a section: that section's text, original and translation row by row, up to ~24k characters; if truncated, call again with paragraph = next_paragraph to read on. With find: every row in the work (or in one section) containing all search words in any order, accent- and breathing-insensitive (e.g. find "αλοω κατα ποντον" or "worse than a brother"), with section and paragraph to read it. With find and mode "concordance": every occurrence of a word or phrase, in the original and the translation, each with the words around it, the same place in the other language and its link, 50 to a page.

find.description: Text to find inside the work, in any of its languages.

id.description: The work: its id or address name from search_shelf (e.g. "plato-republic"), or a scriptura.si link.

mode.description: "concordance" lists every occurrence of find, a page at a time. Default "find".

paragraph.description: Start reading the section at this paragraph (1-based). Default 1.
